script_text: Wake up, Aquarius, the 7th House is screaming your name this week. Early Monday through Wednesday, Mercury turns direct in your 7th House while the Sun opposes Saturn, both rulers you honor, making negotiations tense and slow for your career goals. Wednesday is rough because Mercury's direct motion stirs 7th House debts. Mid-week the shift is undeniable: Venus conjuncts your Sun in Libra, unlocking romance and professional clarity. By Thursday, Mars sextiles that solar energy, shifting focus to your 5th House of joy and self-expression. Love finds you unexpectedly in a public setting, while a career contract signed Friday brings real money. Friday is your power day because Venus lights up your 7th House. Wednesday is your challenge day due to Saturn's shadow. Breathe deeply, Air sign ruled by Uranus; trust your intuition and wait on signatures until the Moon calms. Follow for daily updates.
